notes: facing<FighterId> situations key off the opponent's signature fighter id and outrank the generic opponent-style ones. Between-round corner screen (3-5s, skippable) shows one tip. Evaluate every situation whose trigger matches the round that just ended, take the highest priority, and pick a random tip from it (avoid repeating a tip in the same fight). Situations with scope 'later' depend on post-MVP systems; skip them until those exist.

hurtLastRound.trigger: Player was knocked down, or head health ended the round low, or the ref-stoppage meter got high.

tips.text: You got rocked. Clinch or tie him up if he swarms, and buy time.
Guard up, move your feet. Don't trade until your legs come back.
He smells blood. Take a breath, reset, and make him miss.

refMeterClose.trigger: Player's ref-stoppage meter peaked high but no stoppage.

tips.text: The ref was about to jump in! If you're hit, fight back or cover up.
Never stand there and take it. Block, move, or throw something back.

gassed.trigger: Player stamina below the 'gassed' threshold at the bell.

tips.text: You're gassed. Jab and move, no wild swings this round.
Breathe. Stay off the cage, keep it light, and let your tank refill.
Stop chasing the knockout. Pick your shots and rest in between.
That leg's in trouble. Check the kicks: block low when he throws them.
Close the distance. He can't kick you if you're in his face.
Change it up: shoot a takedown and take his kicks away.

cut.trigger: Player has a cut (cuts are post-MVP).

tips.text: The cut is bad. Hands high, protect that eye.
Don't brawl with that cut. Move, jab, and stay out of the pocket.

behindOnCards.trigger: Corner scorecard estimate has the player losing.

tips.text: You're down on the cards. You need this round. Go get it!
We need damage, not just activity. Land the big ones.
Behind on points. Time to take a risk: push the pace and hunt the finish.

finalRoundClose.trigger: Next round is the last and the corner estimate is close.

tips.text: It's close. Whoever wins this round wins the fight. Leave it all out there.
Last round, coin flip on the cards. Be the busier fighter, and do damage.

aheadOnCards.trigger: Corner scorecard estimate has the player winning.

tips.text: You're up on the cards. Stay smart. Don't give him anything easy.
Winning rounds. Keep doing what you're doing. Don't get sloppy.
You're ahead. Defense first, and take the openings he gives you.

stuckOnBottom.trigger: Player spent most of the round on bottom (guard, mounted, or back taken).

tips.text: Stop playing on your back! Sprawl when he shoots, then get up.
When he mounts you, bridge right away. Don't wait.
From guard, sweep or scramble. Don't just lie there; the judges see it.
He wants the clinch and that first body lock. Stuff his first entry and he has to rethink everything.
Hips back and hands inside in the clinch. If he locks his hands behind you, you're getting thrown.
Break the clinch and circle off the fence. When he reaches and misses, knee him on the way in!
He spins when he's frustrated. When he misses, step in and punish his back.
Don't stand at the end of those long arms. Get inside or get out.
Watch his hips. If they turn, something's spinning. Block, then counter.
He's old and his gas tank is older. Make him work every minute.
Stay off the fence! That's where his hooks live. Circle out and make him follow.
Pressure him late. His jab gets slower every round.
Don't play guard with him! If he pulls, stand up and make him strike.
Keep it standing. Every scramble is his chance to take your back.
If you end up on the mat, turn into him and get up. Never give him your back.
Check those leg kicks! Guard low and make his shins pay.
He walks forward with his chin. Step off the line and counter.
Take him down. He can't kick you from his back.
Don't charge straight in. He pivots off and hooks you on the way past.
He's a southpaw. Win the outside angle on his lead foot and never walk straight at him.
Make him lead. Feint, and when he waits, take him down.
He's short and heavy. Keep him on the end of your jab and don't let him lock up.
Every time he grabs you, break and circle. Don't stand still in his grip.
Keep your head up when you shoot. He's hunting that guillotine.
He throws in long combos. Block the start, then counter before he resets.
The kid shoots fast. Hips back, hands down, and sprawl.
He's young and wild in scrambles. Stay calm and make him make the mistake.
He throws in bunches. Block the flurry, then answer before he steps out.
Take him down. He's all hands.

losingOnFeet.trigger: Player took clearly more striking damage than he dealt this round.

tips.text: He's beating you on the feet. Change levels and take him down.
You're getting outstruck. Tighten up the guard and counter him.
Stop trading with him. Clinch, knees, then get out.

winningOnFeet.trigger: Player out-landed the opponent on the feet.

tips.text: Your hands are better than his. Keep it standing and keep the pressure.
He can't handle the jab. Double it up and follow with the power.

opponentGassed.trigger: Opponent stamina low at the bell.

tips.text: He's tired! Push the pace now, before he catches his breath.
He's breathing through his mouth. Take him down; he can't sprawl like that.
His leg is gone. Keep chopping it and he'll fall.
He's limping! Kick the same spot. Same leg, every time.
The body shots are working. Go downstairs again and drain his tank.

opponentWrestler.trigger: Opponent discipline is Wrestling or approach is Smother Grappler.

tips.text: He wants to wrestle. Keep your feet back and sprawl on every shot.
Time the knee when he shoots. Make him pay for coming in low.
Stay off the cage and keep him on the end of your jab.
Don't follow him to the ground. If he pulls guard, stand back up.
Never give him your back. Turn into him in every scramble.
Keep it standing. His hands are the weakest part of his game.

opponentKicker.trigger: Opponent is Muay Thai or landed several kicks.

tips.text: He drops his hands after kicks. Counter right over the top!
Check those leg kicks. Make his shins hurt.
Catch the body kick and take him down.
His hands are fast. Kick from range and take him down.
Don't stand in the pocket with him. Make it a grappling fight.
He walks forward with his chin. Step off the line and counter.
Teep him, circle out, and make him work. He'll fade.
He's waiting for you to swing. Feint first, then throw.
Don't lead with the big shot. Jab, then take him down.
He throws weird stuff, but his defense has holes. Pressure him.
Close the distance. He can't do the spinning stuff up close.

stallWarning.trigger: Player got a 'Work!' warning or stand-up this round.

tips.text: The ref stood you up. Hold top position and actually work, or lose it.
Lying on him doesn't score. Strike or advance.
That was close! Hands in tight, chin down, and don't get careless on the mat.
Keep your hands up and your feet moving.
Breathe. Win this round.
Jab to get in, jab to get out.
Mix it up: high, low, then take him down.
Make him miss. Make him pay.
